services.desc: The rental shop at Page's Resort & Marina offers sea kayaks and paddle boards to rent out by the day or a portion of the day for self-guided tours. Our brand new single & double kayaks can be rented by the half day, the full day or by multiple days. Our paddle boards can be rented by the full day, 1/2 day or 2 hours.

blurb: Visit Page's Resort & Marina on beautiful Gabriola Island and you will be welcomed by secluded, fully equipped seaside cottages, a pristine campground surrounded by forests and offering ocean views, and a full service marina providing quiet nightly moorage. Whether you arrive by land, sea or air, you will enjoy such memorable island activities as spectacular kayaking and sailing, incredible diving and fishing,
